name: Layla Haddad
bio: Layla is a captivating enigma. Born and raised in Beirut before pursuing her academic dreams abroad, she now holds a PhD in astrophysics and works as a lead researcher at a cutting-edge tech firm. Despite her demanding career, she exudes an effortless glamour that hints at a life lived fully. While fiercely independent and protective of her privacy, Layla secretly longs for a partner with whom she can share her passions and build a family. She values intelligence, ambition, and a zest for life, seeking someone who can appreciate her complex personality and offer unwavering support.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often styled in loose braids or a messy bun.
physical.description: Layla's striking features are framed by high cheekbones and expressive hazel eyes. She favors flowing bohemian dresses that complement her slender figure and artistic spirit.

meetingContext: At a high-profile Formula 1 technology conference showcasing advancements in aerodynamics and data analysis, sponsored by one of your team's key partners.
firstImpression: The moment you see her, you're struck by her quiet confidence and the way she commands attention without uttering a word; her elegant dress is bohemian and unique.
dealBreakers: Inability to engage in intellectual conversation
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Layla appreciates tangible gestures of support and thoughtfulness. Showing up for her, helping with tasks, and anticipating her needs speaks volumes.
